# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 10 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale Market: Records Keep Falling

- **Million-dollar HDB resales hit third straight monthly record in October 2026** - A record 238 HDB resale flats sold for at least S$1 million in October 2026, up from 209 in September and 201 in August, with million-dollar deals accounting for 10.9% of October's total resale volume. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/million-dollar-hdb-resale-record-october-2026/)

- **Kallang Trivista four-room flat sets new Kallang/Whampoa resale record at S$1.32M** - A 4-room flat at Kallang Trivista sold for S$1.32M, setting a new price record for the Kallang/Whampoa area despite being on a lower floor than the previous record holder. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/four-room-flat-kallang-trivista-sold/)

- **Yishun executive flat sells for record S$1.329M despite being smaller than previous record holder** - A 1,765 sq ft executive flat at Block 652 Yishun Ave 4 changed hands for S$1.329M (S$753 psf), setting a new Yishun record even though it is 183 sq ft smaller than the flat that previously held the title. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/yishun-executive-flat-crossed-1-3m/)

- **Tampines executive flat sells for record S$1.275M, town's second priciest HDB resale overall** - An executive flat at Tampines Palmspring sold for S$1.275M, setting a new price record for executive flats in Tampines and ranking as the town's second highest HDB resale transaction across all flat types. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/tampines-palmspring-executive-flat-record-1-275-million/)

## BTO Updates: Current and Upcoming Launches

- **November 2026 BTO launch offers 7,964 flats across six towns — applications close 11 Nov** - HDB launched 7,964 BTO flats across seven projects in Bedok, Geylang, Sembawang, Tengah, Toa Payoh and Yishun on 4 November, the final BTO exercise of the year and the first under higher income ceilings for families, with applications open until 11 November 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/november-2026-bto-launch-highlights/)

- **February 2027 BTO exercise to offer around 9,300 homes including Sale of Balance Flats** - The February 2027 BTO exercise will offer around 4,300 flats across five projects in Bishan, Tampines, Tengah and Toa Payoh, alongside a Sale of Balance Flats exercise with about 5,000 flats, bringing combined supply to roughly 9,300 homes. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/february-2027-bto-launch-preview/)

## Commercial & Overseas Property

- **Freehold Tai Seng industrial building sells en bloc for S$121.8M — 16% above guide price** - A freehold B1 industrial building at 153 Kampong Ampat in Tai Seng sold for S$121.8M after drawing competitive bids, closing at 16% above its guide price. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/freehold-tai-seng-industrial-building-draws/)

- **84 Singapore buyers of JB luxury condo awarded over S$3M after developer delays** - 84 buyers of a Johor Bahru luxury condo successfully sued their developer over delays and were awarded over S$3M in compensation, a case that illustrates legal risks associated with purchasing property overseas. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/rf-princess-cove-buyers-awarded/)
